# confluent-platform Provider

Terraform provider for self-managed Confluent Platform 8.0-8.3.

## Implemented Services

- REST Proxy: Kafka topics, ACLs, and read-only cluster metadata.
- Metadata Service: RBAC role bindings, centralized ACLs, cluster registry, audit configuration, and read-only metadata lookups.
- Kafka Connect: connector lifecycle and connector/cluster status and configuration reads.
- Schema Registry and ksqlDB: configured endpoints, implementation pending.

```terraform
provider "confluent-platform" {
  rest_proxy_endpoint = var.rest_proxy_endpoint
  mds_endpoint        = var.mds_endpoint
  connect_endpoint    = var.connect_endpoint
}
```

See the resource and data source pages for imports, lifecycle behavior, sensitive state, and API prerequisites.
